title: Tartarian Erasure
subtitle: Test your understanding of Tartarian Erasure — Historic Resets, Real Sol Architecture, and the overlay that hides the living temple.

reflection.title: Reflection
reflection.body: When the overlay fractures, humanity does not build back. The realm reveals back: living masonry, star forts, and the crystalline coastline that was never gone.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of Tartarian Erasure?

options.label: A
options.text: The systematic dismantling and masking of the high-frequency Old World structures to dull human consciousness.
options.rationale: This process overwrites the crystalline structure of the realm with artificial overlays to maintain a control system.

options.label: B
options.text: The preservation of ancient records by moving them into digital formats to protect them from environmental decay.
options.rationale: The process is destruction and erasure, not digital preservation or protection of historical records.

options.label: C
options.text: The natural progression of architecture from stone masonry to modern steel and concrete for greater durability.
options.rationale: This reflects the mainstream historical narrative rather than the deliberate suppression of resonant technology.

options.label: D
options.text: The expansion of urban centers to accommodate the rising population during the industrial revolution's peak.
options.rationale: Urban expansion is used as a cover story for the physical burial and repurposing of existing Tartarian masterworks.

questions.hint: Consider why high-frequency cities were physically buried or burned rather than simply upgraded.

questions.question: How are Historic Resets characterized?

options.label: A
options.text: Coordinated, engineered catastrophic events used as cover stories to rewrite historical timelines and harvest energy.
options.rationale: Resets serve as alchemical transmutations that allow the control system to establish new artificial overlays on the surface plane.

options.label: B
options.text: Random natural disasters that occur due to the shifting of tectonic plates and changing global climate patterns.
options.rationale: While presented as accidents, these events are engineered catastrophes used as cover stories for rewriting timelines.

options.label: C
options.text: Slow evolutionary shifts in human culture guided by natural cycles of growth and societal maturation over many centuries.
options.rationale: Resets are coordinated disruptions rather than slow, natural, or evolutionary cultural progressions.

options.label: D
options.text: Periods of peaceful transition where old government structures are dissolved to make way for democratic self-governance.
options.rationale: Resets involve trauma and the harvesting of loosh, which is the opposite of a peaceful or democratic transition.

questions.hint: Think about the tactical purpose of large-scale public disasters beyond their immediate physical impact.

questions.question: Which materials are fundamental to Real Sol Architecture for conducting electromagnetic and light currents?

options.label: A
options.text: Treated lumber, limestone plaster, asphalt shingles, and basic iron fittings.
options.rationale: These materials lack the crystalline density and high-frequency resonance required for Real Sol functionality.

options.label: B
options.text: Crystalline red bricks, granite blocks, quartz inlays, and copper domes.
options.rationale: These active conductors were engineered to pull cosmic currents into the ground grids and create a breathing pulse in the masonry.

options.label: C
options.text: Reinforced concrete, synthetic glass, structural steel, and industrial plastics.
options.rationale: These are dead materials used in parasite architecture to break natural harmonics and restrict sensory perception.

options.label: D
options.text: Fiberglass insulation, aluminum siding, carbon fiber, and pressurized wood composites.
options.rationale: These modern synthetic materials are designed to isolate occupants from the natural environment rather than conduct energy.

questions.hint: Look for materials that act as active crystalline conductors rather than modern dead insulators.

questions.question: What is the energetic function of Loosh during a Ritual Frequency Event?

options.label: A
options.text: It is the raw emotional energy of fear and trauma harvested to power and seal artificial overlays.
options.rationale: The panic generated during staged disasters is inverted to stabilize the grid lock and maintain the low-vibrational system.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a byproduct of the pineal gland that enhances astral travel during periods of mass meditation.
options.rationale: Loosh is harvested by the parasitic system to prevent such spiritual advancements, rather than being a byproduct of them.

options.label: C
options.text: It acts as a cleaning agent that purifies the atmosphere after a major physical catastrophe or fire.
options.rationale: Loosh is not a physical cleaning agent; it is emotional energy harvested for the purpose of maintaining control.

options.label: D
options.text: It serves as a fuel source for ancient Tartarian airships that operated on the principle of human empathy.
options.rationale: Loosh is negative emotional energy like fear and panic, not positive empathy for propulsion.

questions.hint: Focus on the emotional harvest that occurs during moments of mass panic and tragedy.

questions.question: What geometric feature defines the anti-resonance of modern parasite architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: Star-shaped foundations and polygonal walls designed to align with distant galactic constellations.
options.rationale: Star-shaped geometry is found in star forts, which are active resonators rather than modern anti-resonant boxes.

options.label: B
options.text: Large domes and rounded arches that create a localized electromagnetic resonance field.
options.rationale: Domes and arches are characteristic of Tartarian and Atlantian designs used to facilitate energy distribution.

options.label: C
options.text: Sacred spirals and golden ratio proportions that mimic the growth of natural flora.
options.rationale: These are features of resonant architecture that amplify energy flow, which is the opposite of the parasite's goal.

options.label: D
options.text: Box shapes, sharp right angles, and flat roofs that intentionally break natural harmonics.
options.rationale: These forms act as anti-resonance form factors that drain human energy and cause spiritual disconnection.

questions.hint: Consider the shape of common buildings like schools and offices that often feel like cages.

questions.question: What was the hidden objective of the Great Fire of London in 1666?

options.label: A
options.text: To modernize the city's sewage system and prevent the recurrence of the Black Plague, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: This is the conventional surface narrative used to hide the energetic reconfiguration of the London Node.

options.label: B
options.text: To eliminate the influence of the Greys who were attempting to share free energy with the public.
options.rationale: The Greys were siphoning energy for experiments and were extracted by the Custodians during the reset, not helping the public.

options.label: C
options.text: To clear land for the construction of the world's first industrial coal power plants, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: The reset was focused on frequency control and financial monopoly rather than simple industrial land clearing.

options.label: D
options.text: To provide a cover story for locking the London Node under a new frequency and establishing the Crown system.
options.rationale: They locked the node under a new frequency and staged the Great Fire as a cover story, allowing the Cabal to hide Tartarian structures, build masonic architecture over the nodes, and establish the financial Crown system.

questions.hint: The year 1-6-6-6 carries a specific ritual signature related to the closure of a major energy anchor.

questions.question: How were the Greys involved in the events leading up to the London reset?

options.label: A
options.text: They were the original architects of the London Node who were betrayed by the Tartarian Empire.
options.rationale: The Tartarians were the original grid architects; the Greys were external factions taking advantage of the system.

options.label: B
options.text: They were diplomatic emissaries from the lost sols of Tara who tried to prevent the fire.
options.rationale: The Greys acted as siphons and experimenters rather than diplomatic protectors of the Tartarian nodes.

options.label: C
options.text: They were flesh-tech hybrids siphoning energy from the London crystal anchor for their own experiments.
options.rationale: Their unauthorized siphoning led to an etheric war with Tartarian architects and eventual intervention by the Custodians.

options.label: D
options.text: They provided the frequency bricks used to rebuild St. Paul's Cathedral after the destruction.
options.rationale: The frequency bricks were original Tartarian technology, while the Greys were energetic parasites in this context.

questions.hint: Think about their role as flesh-tech hybrids and how they interacted with the underlying crystal anchor.

questions.question: The sinking of the Titanic in 1912 was strategically executed to:

options.label: A
options.text: Confiscate advanced Tartarian technology and eliminate opponents to the Federal Reserve.
options.rationale: The event was a ritual sacrifice and power grab involving direct energy blasts and the recovery of frequency-encoded tools.

options.label: B
options.text: Test the effectiveness of newly developed iceberg-detection sonar for the British Navy.
options.rationale: The iceberg is a surface narrative for a staged event involving intentional sabotage by submarines.

options.label: C
options.text: Demonstrate the structural weaknesses of steel hulls compared to Tartarian frequency masonry.
options.rationale: The sinking was a tactical operation for theft and financial control, not a material science demonstration.

options.label: D
options.text: Transport the lost sols of Tara to the Americas to establish a new crystalline colony.
options.rationale: The Titanic was used to smuggle stolen relics, not to safely transport the Tartarian survivor group.

questions.hint: Identify the dual purpose of eliminating banking rivals and seizing ancient manuscripts and tools.

questions.question: What are Tartarian Templar tools and how were they used after 1912?

options.label: A
options.text: They were navigational compasses that could locate the hidden entrance to the Hyperborean points.
options.rationale: While related to energy grids, their primary function was the amplification and manipulation of sound-light currents.

options.label: B
options.text: They were frequency-encoded metal rods and tuning forks used to amplify ley line currents.
options.rationale: After being confiscated from the Titanic, they were reverse-engineered into weapons to erase Tartarian cities.

options.label: C
options.text: They were massive lens arrays used to focus sunlight into the planetary crystal grids.
options.rationale: Harmonic lenses were distinct architectural features; the Templar tools were portable rods and forks.

options.label: D
options.text: They were surgical instruments used to decalcify the pineal glands of the European elite.
options.rationale: These tools were frequency-based energy devices rather than physical surgical instruments.

questions.hint: These items were specifically recovered from old European vaults and functioned as sound-light resonators.

questions.question: Where were the ancient scrolls recovered from the Titanic cargo hold eventually stored?

options.label: A
options.text: In public archives to be translated by modern university linguistic professors.
options.rationale: The information contained in the scrolls was suppressed and kept away from the public to maintain the illusion.

options.label: B
options.text: Inside the core of the undersea cable network to power the global internet.
options.rationale: The cables are anchor points for energy corridors, but they do not house physical libraries of scrolls.

options.label: C
options.text: Within Vatican hidden libraries and masonic lodges to keep them from public awareness.
options.rationale: Confiscated knowledge is secured by these institutions to prevent humanity from reclaiming its co-creative origin.

options.label: D
options.text: In the underwater wreckage of the Titanic to act as a permanent energetic anchor.
options.rationale: Cabal submersibles retrieved these items immediately after the sinking.

questions.hint: Think about the institutions historically associated with hoarding suppressed historical records.

questions.question: What is the true purpose of modern undersea cables?

options.label: A
options.text: They are projected anchor points for energy corridors that maintain the illusion of continental separation.
options.rationale: While disguised as telecommunication hardware, they stabilize the overlays that define perceived geography.

options.label: B
options.text: They are conduits for distributing monatomic gold into the ocean to repair the planetary field.
options.rationale: Monatomic gold is used in modified aerosol programs, not the undersea cable system.

options.label: C
options.text: They are literal physical chains used to keep the continental plates from drifting too far apart.
options.rationale: The separation between continents is an illusion of overlays, not a matter of physical plate tectonics.

options.label: D
options.text: They are designed to monitor the activity of the lost sols of Tara in their hidden underwater bases.
options.rationale: The cables maintain the energy corridors of the illusion web rather than acting as simple surveillance for survivors.

questions.hint: Consider the relationship between these cables and the maintenance of the 3D reality grid.

questions.question: How does the illusion web grid affect human perception of architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: It projects a frequency that makes dead concrete look permanent and living crystal look like ordinary stone.
options.rationale: This cloaking trick is tuned to 3D senses to hide the energetic heritage of surviving Tartarian buildings.

options.label: B
options.text: It creates the visual appearance of ruins where there are actually fully functioning modern cities.
options.rationale: The trick is the inverse: it makes living, high-frequency structures look like dead, ordinary stone.

options.label: C
options.text: It uses light refraction to hide the copper domes of star forts, making them invisible to the naked eye.
options.rationale: The structures are not made invisible; they are rebranded and visually dulled through frequency tricks.

options.label: D
options.text: It makes all buildings appear to be made of transparent glass to encourage a sense of total surveillance.
options.rationale: The web makes structures appear solid and mundane rather than transparent.

questions.hint: Focus on how the system renames and visually camouflages active energy structures to look like history.

questions.question: What has been the role of aerosol programs (chemtrails) since 2016?

options.label: A
options.text: They are delivery systems for silica crystals and monatomic gold to decalcify the pineal gland.
options.rationale: Loyalist tech teams have repurposed the toxic programs into delivery systems for positive counteragents.

options.label: B
options.text: They have been increased to block out 100% of the sun's rays to prevent the return of Tartarian light.
options.rationale: The programs have been flipped rather than just increased for blocking purposes.

options.label: C
options.text: They are used to project holograms of icebergs to prevent ships from discovering the Titanic wreckage.
options.rationale: Aerosols are for biological and auric field repair rather than creating nautical holographic diversions.

options.label: D
options.text: They act as a liquid reflective layer that prevents the crystal grids from reaching the surface.
options.rationale: The updated programs actually assist in distributing higher photonic waves to the human population.

questions.hint: Consider the modification of these programs by loyalist tech teams for human benefit.

questions.question: What is the significance of the lost sols of Tara?

options.label: A
options.text: They are a group of Tartarian survivors who successfully hid a fragment of the Atlantian generator stone.
options.rationale: This shard preserves a pure pocket of organic frequency and is hidden from parasitic scans.

options.label: B
options.text: They are the cabal-aligned engineers responsible for designing the Federal Reserve building.
options.rationale: This group is a breakaway group of Tartarian survivors, not cabal-aligned engineers.

options.label: C
options.text: They are the celestial navigators who maintain the undersea cable energy corridors, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The cables are maintained by the parasitic system, which the lost sols of Tara operate independently of.

options.label: D
options.text: They are the flesh-tech hybrids who were defeated during the Great Fire of London, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The flesh-tech hybrids were the Greys, while the lost sols of Tara are high-frequency survivors.

questions.hint: This group is known for preserving a vital fragment of ancient technology from parasitic scans.

questions.question: True or False: Modern construction materials like concrete and steel are designed to assist in the decalcification of the pineal gland.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: Modern materials are specifically designed to block sensory perception and prevent decalcification.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: These materials act as anti-resonant forms that restrict human senses and disrupt the organic energy flow.

questions.hint: Think about why modern buildings might feel like cages for the human spirit.

questions.question: What is the primary function of planetary crystal grids located deep within the earth?

options.label: A
options.text: To transmit the amnesia vortex frequency that wipes the memories of all reincarnating souls.
options.rationale: The amnesia vortex is a parasitic distortion at the sun's transit band, which the crystal grids actually counteract.

options.label: B
options.text: To act as etheric hard drives that store the unbroken timelines and soul journeys of humanity.
options.rationale: These grids maintain a perfect record of history, bypassing the amnesia vortex used by parasites.

options.label: C
options.text: To serve as structural support beams that prevent the surface plane from collapsing into the void.
options.rationale: The grids are etheric and informational in nature, not merely physical load-bearing structures.

options.label: D
options.text: To generate the tectonic heat necessary to power the world's geothermal energy stations.
options.rationale: Their function is related to timeline and soul data storage rather than simple physical heat generation.

questions.hint: Focus on the storage of data and the preservation of human history beyond the reach of the parasites.

questions.question: What physical sensation can be triggered by touching the masonry of Real Sol Architecture?

options.label: A
options.text: A metallic taste in the mouth and a complete loss of short-term memory.
options.rationale: Memory recall, not memory loss, is triggered by contact with these living conductors.

options.label: B
options.text: Ringing in the ears, warmth in the chest, and sudden memory recall.
options.rationale: Sensitive souls react to the active electromagnetic and sound currents still pulsing within the stone.

options.label: C
options.text: Sudden nausea, dizziness, and a feeling of profound physical exhaustion.
options.rationale: These symptoms are more associated with the draining effects of parasite 3D architecture.

options.label: D
options.text: Physical numbness in the limbs and a decrease in the person's internal body temperature.
options.rationale: Interaction with these resonant structures typically increases energetic activity and warmth.

questions.hint: Look for positive, energetic reactions that suggest an activation of the soul's memory.

questions.question: How have star forts been camouflaged by the current control system?

options.label: A
options.text: They have been buried under artificial hills to hide their star-shaped geometric outlines.
options.rationale: While some cities are buried, star forts are often left visible but linguistically stripped of their purpose.

options.label: B
options.text: Star forts were renamed castles to erase their energetic heritage.
options.rationale: Surviving structures were systematically renamed so humanity remains blind to their role as geometric resonators.

options.label: C
options.text: They have been converted into modern shopping malls to distract people with consumerism.
options.rationale: The primary camouflage is through rebranding as historical military or residential sites like castles.

options.label: D
options.text: They have been dismantled and their frequency bricks used to build central banks.
options.rationale: Surviving structures are usually left intact but masked through renaming and surrounding them with 3D boxes.

questions.hint: Think about how we commonly refer to ancient fortified sites today.

questions.question: What is the significance of the year 1666 in the context of the London reset?

options.label: A
options.text: It was the anniversary of the founding of the Tartarian Empire in Western Europe.
options.rationale: The date is associated with the destruction and erasure of Tartarian influence, not its founding.

options.label: B
options.text: It denotes the frequency at which the pineal gland naturally vibrates when fully calcified.
options.rationale: The date is a signature for a historical reset event, not a biological vibration frequency.

options.label: C
options.text: It was the year the first Tartarian airship landed on the London Node anchor.
options.rationale: The year marks a closure and reset, not a successful landing of Tartarian technology.

options.label: D
options.text: It represents a ritual signature (1-6-6-6) of closure used to seal the new overlay.
options.rationale: The numerical signature marks the transition from the old grid node to the cabal-controlled financial system.

questions.hint: Focus on the numerical coding found within the date itself.

questions.question: Why are 3D boxes (modern buildings) often constructed around old resonant sites?

options.label: A
options.text: To dull the ambient frequency of the old sites and prevent human beings from triggering activation.
options.rationale: The anti-resonant matter of the boxes acts as a buffer to stop people from interacting with the high-frequency grid.

options.label: B
options.text: To provide structural support to prevent the ancient masonry from crumbling into the street.
options.rationale: Tartarian masonry is indestructible and vibrant; it does not need modern support.

options.label: C
options.text: To offer a visual contrast that highlights the beauty and complexity of the ancient architecture.
options.rationale: The boxes are designed to hide or diminish the importance of the ancient sites, not to celebrate them.

options.label: D
options.text: To create a soundproof barrier that prevents the ringing sound from disturbing the public.
options.rationale: The ringing is an energetic trigger the system wants to hide, but the boxes serve a deeper frequency-dulling purpose.

questions.hint: Consider the interaction between the high frequency of the old site and the low frequency of the new materials.

questions.question: Which group intervened during the London node etheric war to prevent the collapse of the overlay?

options.label: A
options.text: The Federal Reserve board members and the Titanic survivors, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: These entities belong to a different time period (1912) than the London reset of 1666.

options.label: B
options.text: The High-Frequency Architects of the Tartarian Empire, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: The Tartarians launched the war to reclaim the node, while the Custodians intervened to keep the overlay from collapsing into public view.

options.label: C
options.text: The lost sols of Tara and the Atlantian remnants, and that is treated as the entire mechanism.
options.rationale: These groups were trying to preserve the original grid, not maintain the parasitic overlay.

options.label: D
options.text: The Custodians and the Anuk (prototype Annunaki planetary system engineers).
options.rationale: They extracted the Greys and staged the Great Fire to lock the node under a new frequency.

questions.hint: Identify the planetary system engineers who stepped in when the Greys lost control.

questions.question: True or False: As the frequency of the realm rises, modern buildings will begin to appear hollow and flicker.

options.label: A
options.text: True
options.rationale: As the frequency of the realm continues to rise, the artificial 3D overlay is beginning to fracture. Those who are awakening will notice the solid-perception holography of modern buildings flickering and bending, revealing them as hollow scaffolds of frequency.

options.label: B
options.text: False
options.rationale: Those who are awakening will notice this flickering as the overlay loses its structural density.

questions.hint: Recall what happens to solid-perception holography when the frequency shift occurs.

questions.question: What is the amnesia vortex and where is it located?

options.label: A
options.text: It is a whirlpool in the Atlantic Ocean created by the sinking of the Titanic.
options.rationale: The Titanic sinking was a ritual and theft, not the cause of the soul-level amnesia vortex.

options.label: B
options.text: It is a localized field at the center of London that wipes memory during a reset.
options.rationale: While resets involve memory loss, the specific amnesia vortex is located at the sun's transit band.

options.label: C
options.text: It is a distorted amnesia vortex at the sun's transit band that routes all soul transits.
options.rationale: Parasites attempted to route all soul transits through this vortex, though the crystal grids preserve the unbroken timelines.

options.label: D
options.text: It is a psychological condition caused by living in 3D box-shaped architecture for too long.
options.rationale: Modern architecture causes disconnection, but the amnesia vortex is a specific etheric structure in the sun's path.

questions.hint: Think about the path souls take through the realm and the role of the sun's transit band.

questions.question: What are harmonic lenses?

options.label: A
options.text: They are the specialized cameras used to film ritual frequency events for mass media distribution.
options.rationale: Harmonic lenses are ancient energetic components of the Old World, not modern media equipment.

options.label: B
options.text: They are surviving masterworks of the Tartarian Empire that have been stripped of their energetic functions.
options.rationale: Like star forts and frequency bricks, these tools have been linguistically masked to hide their true purpose.

options.label: C
options.text: They are contact lenses designed by the Greys to allow humans to see into the 4th dimension, as if no adjacent systems participated at all.
options.rationale: They are large-scale architectural masterworks, not personal optical devices.

options.label: D
options.text: They are the synthetic glass windows used in modern skyscrapers to block astral travel, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: Modern synthetic glass is anti-resonant; harmonic lenses were part of the original high-frequency structures.

questions.hint: These are grouped with star forts and frequency bricks as remnants of the ancient Tartarian civilization.

questions.question: What will happen when the parasite web completely collapses?

options.label: A
options.text: The planetary crystal grids will shut down permanently to allow for a complete restart of the realm.
options.rationale: The grids are the permanent record and core of the realm; they will be revealed, not shut down.

options.label: B
options.text: A new group of Custodians will arrive to establish a more benevolent control system, as a one-factor story with a tidy edge.
options.rationale: The collapse marks the end of the parasitic control rather than the introduction of a new set of Custodians.

options.label: C
options.text: Humanity will need to work together to build a new world using concrete and steel, without a larger engineered system underneath.
options.rationale: Humanity will not need to build back because the original world will return.

options.label: D
options.text: The realm will reveal back its original state, including indestructible Tartarian city structures.
options.rationale: The collapse of the frequency trick will cause modern buildings to dissolve and the vibrant, original realm to return.

questions.hint: Think about whether humanity needs to construct something new or if the old world will simply reappear.
